name: mermaid-tty
description: Draws the mermaid fences in Claude's replies as colored box-drawing diagrams in the terminal.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: nord is the default; default follows your Claude Code theme; the other curated palettes use their official colors, and mono draws without color. /mermaid-tty theme <name> switches at runtime.

direction.title: Flowchart direction
direction.description: The direction Claude is asked to write flowcharts in: LR (left to right) suits a terminal, which is wider than it is tall; TB is top to bottom; off asks for nothing. Diagrams always draw as their source says. /mermaid-tty direction switches at runtime.
